summary: Arvin slams his palm against a heavy red manual override button on the control console. Milo ducks behind a reinforced shielding plate, his eyes squeezed shut against the sudden, blinding brilliance of the rocket’s chemical ignition as the ground begins to shudder violently. The roar of the engine is a physical wall of sound that vibrates the very air, forcing both men to lean into the blast to avoid being knocked over.

summary: Arvin and Lucia trudge through the rising sandstorm, their bodies leaning into the wind as the orange sky swallows the horizon. Arvin clutches a handheld diagnostic screen, its surface cracked and covered in dust, while Lucia looks back at the fading silhouette of their abandoned mobile base. The sand scours their skin and clogs their clothes, turning their silhouettes into ghostly shapes in the orange haze.
settingText: The sandstorm creates a wall of physical texture that obscures the world, forcing the audience to focus on the grit on the characters' teeth and the way they shield their eyes with their sleeves. summary: Arvin crouches in the sharp shadow of a rusted turbine housing, scraping thick orange oxidation from a titanium bolt using a bone-handled knife. Milo stands nearby, shielding his eyes with a grease-stained palm as he scans the shimmering horizon for the glint of corporate drones.
settingText: Arvin and Milo in the Mojave scrap-fields.
